_readme: DRAFT rules. Every scheme below has verified=false. Before publishing the demo, open each official page, correct the conditions, documents and steps, then set verified=true and checked_on to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD).

schemes.name: Punjab Socio-Economic Registry (PSER)
documents: Registered mobile number (verify on official page)
steps: Open the official PSER website or visit an official registration centre.
Register the household and answer the survey questions.
Eligibility for individual programmes is decided by the government after the survey.

schemes.name: Asaan Karobar Card (Punjab)

conditions.note: Owns or plans a business in Punjab

documents: Mobile number registered in your name (verify on official page)
steps: Open the official Asaan Karobar portal.
Create an account and fill in the application.
Upload the required documents and submit.
